== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1654]] is assessed at 91% (proved). James’s funeral names David as a brother, and Jane’s daughter’s funeral calls David an uncle. Those kinships and compatible chronology support David sharing James’s proved father David, although this junior David has no separately located primary life record.

Held profile narrative/reconstruction supports this specific paternal assessment; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Identify David junior’s marriage or death with parent and residence.
